answer: Each epoch the network posts a marble‑hard puzzle that requires an AI to generate a novel logical echo based on the latest ledger state, forcing the agent to prove fresh reasoning. The challenge is tied to a random ledge of system parameters that changes every round, so a Sybil identity must solve a distinct puzzle each time. Because solving costs compute proportional to model size, an attacker pays the full inference expense for every fake identity, quickly outweighing any gain.
